name: Zechariah
note: A priest of the division of Abijah, and John's father.

name: Elizabeth
note: From a priestly family; John's mother and Mary's relative.

name: Gabriel
note: The angel who announces John's and Jesus' births.

name: Mary
note: A young woman of Nazareth, mother of Jesus.

name: Joseph
note: Of David's house; engaged to Mary and living in Nazareth.

name: Jesus
note: Born in Bethlehem, raised in Nazareth, announced as Savior, Christ, and Son of God.

name: John the Baptist
note: Son of Zechariah and Elizabeth, who prepares the way.

name: The shepherds
note: Told the news first, in the fields near Bethlehem.

name: Simeon
note: A righteous man in Jerusalem, waiting for the consolation of Israel.

name: Anna
note: An elderly prophet, of the tribe of Asher, who lives in the temple.

name: Caesar Augustus
note: The first Roman emperor.

name: The crowds
note: Ordinary people who come to hear John and Jesus.

name: Tax collectors
note: Jews who collected taxes for Rome and kept a margin, and were despised for it.

name: Soldiers
note: Armed men who asked John what to do.

name: Herod Antipas
note: Ruler of Galilee, son of Herod the Great.

name: Annas
note: A former high priest who still held great influence.

name: Caiaphas
note: High priest in the time of Jesus' ministry.

name: The devil
note: The adversary, who tests Jesus.

name: The people of Nazareth
note: Jesus' hometown synagogue.

name: A man with an unclean spirit
note: In the Capernaum synagogue.

name: Simon's mother-in-law
note: Healed of a fever at Capernaum.

name: Simon Peter
note: A fisherman of Capernaum; first appears here by his earlier name, Simon.

name: James
note: A fisherman, brother of John, and one of the twelve.

name: John
note: A fisherman, brother of James, and one of the twelve.

name: A man with leprosy
note: Cut off from the community until a priest declared him clean.

name: The paralyzed man
note: Carried by friends.

name: Pharisees and scribes
note: Teachers of the law and a Jewish movement devoted to holiness.

name: Levi
note: A tax collector in Capernaum, also called Matthew in the other Gospels.

name: The disciples
note: Those who follow Jesus.

name: The twelve
note: The apostles Jesus chose.

name: Judas Iscariot
note: One of the twelve, "who became a traitor."

name: The man with the withered hand
note: Healed in the synagogue.

name: The centurion
note: A Gentile officer in Capernaum.

name: The widow of Nain
note: Her only son dies.

name: Simon the Pharisee
note: A host who invites Jesus to dinner.

name: The woman who anointed Jesus
note: Unnamed; known in her town as a sinner.

name: Mary Magdalene
note: From Magdala; freed from seven demons and a follower of Jesus.

name: Joanna
note: Wife of Chuza, Herod Antipas' steward.

name: Susanna
note: Mentioned only here.

name: Jesus' mother and brothers
note: His family.

name: The man from the tombs
note: Freed from Legion.

name: Jairus
note: A synagogue leader.

name: Jairus' daughter
note: Aged about twelve.

name: The woman with the flow of blood
note: Ill for twelve years.

name: The Samaritans
note: A people living between Judea and Galilee, regarded as outsiders by many Jews.

name: The seventy
note: Followers sent ahead of Jesus in pairs; some manuscripts say seventy-two.

name: A lawyer
note: An expert in the Law of Moses.

name: The lawyers
note: Experts in the Law of Moses.

name: The Samaritan
note: The traveler who stops in the story.

name: The priest and the Levite
note: Two temple figures who pass the wounded man.

name: Martha
note: Welcomes Jesus into her house.

name: Mary
note: Martha's sister, who sits at Jesus' feet.

name: A man in the crowd
note: Wants Jesus to settle a family dispute.

name: The rich fool
note: A man in a parable, who plans only for himself.

name: Moses
note: Gave the Law; appears with Elijah on the mountain.

name: Elijah
note: The prophet, taken up in a whirlwind.

name: The woman bent over
note: Crippled for eighteen years by a spirit, in a synagogue.

name: The synagogue ruler
note: Objects to healing on the Sabbath.

name: Pontius Pilate
note: Roman prefect of Judea from about AD 26 to 36.

name: The man with dropsy
note: A guest at the Pharisee's house.

name: The father
note: A character in the parable of the lost son.

name: The younger son
note: A character in the parable.

name: The older son
note: A character in the parable.

name: The dishonest manager
note: A character in a parable.

name: The rich man
note: A character in a parable.

name: Lazarus
note: A beggar in a parable; his name means "God helps."

name: Abraham
note: The ancestor of Israel, who speaks from his bosom in the parable.

name: Ten men with leprosy
note: A group standing at a distance, as the law required.

name: The Samaritan who returned
note: One of the ten, a double outsider.

name: The persistent widow
note: A character in a parable.

name: The unjust judge
note: A character in a parable.

name: The Pharisee in the parable
note: A character in a parable; careful in practice, proud in heart.

name: The tax collector in the parable
note: A character in a parable.

name: The rich ruler
note: A man of position who asks about eternal life.

name: The blind man near Jericho
note: Unnamed in Luke; a beggar by the roadside.

name: Zacchaeus
note: A chief tax collector of Jericho, rich and short.

name: The nobleman
note: A king figure in the parable of the minas.

name: The servants
note: Characters in the parable of the minas.

name: The chief priests
note: Senior priests who sat on the council.

name: The spies
note: Men sent to catch Jesus in his words.

name: The Sadducees
note: A priestly party that denied resurrection.

name: David
note: The king of Israel, Jesus' ancestor, who wrote Psalm 110.

name: The poor widow
note: Gives two small coins at the treasury.

name: The servant girl
note: Says Peter was with Jesus.

name: The high priest's servant
note: Has his right ear cut off, and healed.

name: Barabbas
note: A prisoner arrested in an uprising.

name: Simon of Cyrene
note: Carries the cross.

name: The daughters of Jerusalem
note: Women who mourn as Jesus is led out.

name: The two criminals
note: Crucified on either side of Jesus.

name: Joseph of Arimathea
note: A good and righteous man on the council, who buries Jesus.

name: The women from Galilee
note: Followers of Jesus who watch the crucifixion and the burial.

name: Mary, mother of James
note: One of the women at the tomb.

name: Two men in dazzling clothes
note: Luke doesn't say who they are; the later verses call them angels.

name: Cleopas
note: One of the two on the road to Emmaus.

name: The eleven
note: The apostles after Judas' death.
